title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
The Spanish Data Protection Agency has received its first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent. The unnamed affected organization said an attacker used an AI agent with a known language model to find weaknesses in generic files and log in successfully. Once inside, the agent worked on its own to locate application vulnerabilities, then changed personal data and viewed invoices. The agency stressed that this does not mean the AI model or its provider was compromised, only that a third party used the agent to chain together several attack steps.

This single case is not a statistical trend, but it shows attacks supported by AI are becoming real. The agency says organizations must now include AI driven attacks in risk assessments, speed up response plans, tighten control of credentials and API keys, and rely on automated detection rather than manual oversight alone. The notification will be analyzed further, and data controllers and processors are urged to review their security measures immediately.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
